'''Medo''' is a village in [[Shienar]] which acts as a trading port for the city of [[Fal Moran]], as it lies on the [[River Mora]].{{ref|[http://13depository.blogspot.com/2009/05/great-hunt-read-though-2-survey-of.html 13th Depository: Survey of Sheinar (Great Hunt)]}} It has two stone docks that extend into the village and is slightly larger then [[Emond's Field]].{{ref/book|2|12}}

==Recent activities==
The [[Amyrlin Seat]] [[Siuan Sanche]] and her entourage of [[Aes Sedai]], as well as [[Egwene al'Vere]] and [[Nynaeve al'Meara]], take a river boat called the ''[[River Queen]]'' from Medo to travel towards [[Tar Valon]].{{ref/book|2|12}}

During the [[Last Battle]], it was burned to hinder the advance of the Shadow.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Medo}}
